questions.q: What is one thing a drone bee can NOT do?
questions.fact: Drones can't sting! Only female bees, the workers and the queen, have a stinger.

questions.q: Why do drone bees have such huge eyes?
choices: To spot a queen flying high in the sky
To see in the dark hive
questions.fact: To spot a queen! Their giant eyes help them find a young queen on her mating flight.

questions.q: Do drone bees collect nectar and pollen for the hive?
questions.fact: No! Drones don't have pollen baskets, so the busy worker bees do all the foraging.

questions.q: What usually happens to drones when fall comes?
choices: Workers push them out of the hive
questions.fact: Workers push them out! That saves the honey for winter, and the hive raises new drones in spring.
